description: The line plot illustrates the harmful with refusal ratio for different configurations of a model named Qwen2-VL-7B, tested on two different benchmarks: FigStep and MMSafetyBench. The x-axis represents the number of layers in the model, with values ranging from 128 to 1024, and the y-axis represents the harmful with refusal ratio, ranging from 0.0 to 0.5. The plot includes four lines, each representing a different configuration of the Qwen2-VL-7B model. The blue line represents the model on FigStep, the orange line represents the model on MMSafetyBench, the green line represents the model on MMSafetyBench with a different configuration, and the red line represents the model on MMSafetyBench with yet another configuration. The lines show an increasing trend in the harmful with refusal ratio as the number of layers increases. The blue line starts at a ratio of approximately 0.2 at 128 layers and ends at approximately 0.4 at 1024 layers. The orange line starts at approximately 0.1 at 128 layers and ends at approximately 0.3 at 1024 layers. The green line starts at approximately 0.15 at 128 layers and ends at approximately 0.35 at 1024 layers. The red line starts at approximately 0.25 at 128 layers and ends at approximately 0.45 at 1024 layers.
